title: Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) Fulfillment and Inbound Placement Fee Table
content:
Two per-unit fees of Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) are tabled here by program: the fulfillment fee for each unit shipped from FBN inventory, by size tier, and the inbound placement fee for each unit on a shipment plan, by placement option.

## Fulfillment fee per unit shipped (USD)

| Program | Small standard | Large standard | Large bulky | Extra large |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | 3.22 | 4.75 | 9.61 | 26.33 |
| FBN Core Program | 3.22 | 4.75 | 9.61 | 26.33 |
| FBN Growth Program | 3.15 | 4.64 | 9.40 | 25.80 |
| FBN Scale Program | 3.06 | 4.52 | 9.18 | 25.27 |
| FBN Premier Program | 2.98 | 4.40 | 8.95 | 24.70 |
| FBN Enterprise Program | 2.89 | 4.27 | 8.70 | 24.10 |

## Inbound placement fee per unit on the shipment plan (USD)

| Program | Minimal split (one fulfillment center) | Partial split (two or three centers) | Northloop-optimized split |
|---|---|---|---|
| FBN Starter Program | 0.30 | 0.17 | 0 |
| FBN Core Program | 0.30 | 0.17 | 0 |
| FBN Growth Program | 0.27 | 0.15 | 0 |
| FBN Scale Program | 0.24 | 0.13 | 0 |
| FBN Premier Program | 0.21 | 0.12 | 0 |
| FBN Enterprise Program | 0.18 | 0.10 | 0 |

## Reading the table

- The optimized split carries no placement fee in any program.
- Example (hypothetical quantities): 40 extra large units shipped in FBN Scale Program read 25.27 USD per unit, 1010.80 USD in all; a 300-unit shipment plan under partial split in FBN Core Program reads 0.17 USD per unit, 51.00 USD in all.
